payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_spec_review.py::test_a_failed_send_back_keeps_the_last_draft_that_parsed_and_says_why stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/spec_review.py. The claim was "A send-back that fails ends the send-backs and still ends the session with a text, no error and no reset. A failure is the work turn rate-limited or raised, or its extraction not the schema, rate-limited or raised. The session's text follows criterion 1's rule, the newest text that parsed or else the newest text. It emits one line naming the failure, then each fault line. Each failing turn's cost and turns join the session's. The witness drives all five failures, after a first draft that parsed and after one that did not. With the bound patched to 2 it drives a first draft that parses, a first send-back whose text parses with faults, and a second send-back that fails. The first send-back's text survives.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
